build_lightconv_representation: build a LightConvRepresentation CNN encoder with configurable kernel sizes and pooling type
create_lightconv_config: create a LightConvRepresentation Config with custom encoder kernel size list and pooling type
run_lightconv_forward: run the LightConvRepresentation forward pass on embedded tokens with source tokens and lengths
pool_tensor_with_padding: pool a tensor using mean max or none pooling with an optional padding mask
tile_encoder_output: tile the LightConvRepresentation encoder output by a given tile size for batch expansion
